FAQ.title: What clients ask before signing up

items.question: How much can I actually save with Union National Tax?
items.answer: Most clients reduce their tax burden by 20–40% through proactive structuring — S-Corp elections, retirement contributions, cost segregation, and entity-level deductions. Our construction and restaurant partners average $350K–$400K in savings annually.

items.question: What if I'm already working with a CPA?
items.answer: We complement your existing CPA — we don't replace them. We handle the forward-looking strategy, tax planning, and CFO work; your CPA handles compliance filing. Most clients' CPAs appreciate the cleaner books and proactive planning we deliver.

items.question: What's the difference between your service and a typical CPA?
items.answer: Most CPAs are reactive — they file what you give them once a year. We're advisory-led and year-round: quarterly reviews, real-time bookkeeping, entity structuring, and proactive IRS audit preparation. We treat your finances like a business owner should.

items.question: How do I know if I need CFO services or just tax filing?
items.answer: If your business has more than $500K in revenue, multiple income streams, or you're spending more than 10 hours a year on financial admin — you need more than filing. Schedule a free 30-minute diagnostic and we'll tell you exactly what you need.
